# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 29 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 29:3 — way of repentance and path to life

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the way of repentance and the path to life" | Literal hodos metanoias kai hodos zōēs |
| LOGOS | "the way of repentance and the path to life" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the way of repentance and the path to life" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree. No divergence. Included to note the intentional parallelism of 'way' and 'path' — both render Greek hodos, with variation introduced by EMET for stylistic differentiation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
